fields.title: Python basic
fields.description:
Welcome to the Python Basic course! This course is designed for beginners who want to start their programming journey with one of the most popular and versatile programming languages in the world.

Throughout this course, you will learn the fundamental concepts of Python programming, including variables, data types, control structures, functions, and basic object-oriented programming. You will get hands-on experience writing Python scripts, working with libraries, and solving real-world problems through coding exercises.

By the end of the course, you will be comfortable with writing Python code, understand how to structure programs, and be ready to dive deeper into advanced topics like web development, data science, or automation using Python.

Whether you aim to become a software developer, data analyst, or simply want to automate tasks, this course will provide you with a strong foundation and practical skills to succeed.

fields.title: Java Basic
fields.description:
Welcome to the Java Basic course! This course introduces you to the Java programming language, a powerful, object-oriented language widely used in enterprise applications, Android development, and large-scale systems.

In this course, you will learn core Java concepts such as variables, data types, conditional statements, loops, methods, arrays, and the basics of object-oriented programming including classes, objects, inheritance, and polymorphism.

The course focuses on writing clean, maintainable Java code and understanding the principles behind software development. You will practice coding with exercises and small projects to reinforce your learning.

By completing this course, you will have a solid understanding of Java fundamentals, enabling you to build simple Java applications and prepare for more advanced topics like GUI development, multithreading, and network programming.

This course is ideal for beginners who want to start a career in Java development or enhance their programming skills for software engineering.

fields.title: Foundations of Data Analytics: From Data to Insights
fields.description: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to data analytics, guiding learners through the essential concepts, tools, and techniques used to transform raw data into actionable insights. Ideal for beginners, the course covers data collection, cleaning, exploration, visualization, and basic statistical analysis using industry-standard tools like Excel, Python, and SQL. By the end of the course, students will be able to conduct simple analyses and present their findings effectively.

fields.title: Functions
fields.content: Functions in programming languages

fields.title: Introduction to Java and Setup
fields.content: Learn what Java is, install the JDK and an IDE, and write your first program.

fields.title: Variables and Data Types
fields.content: Understand how to declare variables and use different data types in Java.

fields.title: Operators and Expressions
fields.content: Learn how to perform operations using arithmetic, relational, and logical operators.

fields.title: Control Flow: if, else, switch
fields.content: Use conditional statements to control the flow of your program.

fields.title: Loops: for, while, do-while
fields.content: Learn how to repeat actions using different types of loops.

fields.title: Methods and Parameters
fields.content: Understand how to create reusable code using methods and pass data to them.

fields.title: Object-Oriented Basics: Classes and Objects
fields.content: Learn the core of Java ù how to define classes and create objects.

fields.title: Constructors and the this Keyword
fields.content: Understand how constructors work and use this to refer to the current object.

fields.title: Encapsulation and Access Modifiers
fields.content: Learn how to protect data and control access using private, public, and getters/setters.

fields.title: Arrays and ArrayLists
fields.content: Store and manage multiple values using arrays and dynamic ArrayLists.

fields.title: Strings and String Methods
fields.content: Work with text using JavaÆs String class and its useful methods.

fields.title: Introduction to Python
fields.content: Learn what Python is, install it, and write your first Python script.

fields.title: Variables and Data Types
fields.content: Understand how to store data in variables and use different data types.

fields.title: Operators and Expressions
fields.content: Use arithmetic, comparison, and logical operators in your code.

fields.title: Conditional Statements: if, elif, else
fields.content: Control your programÆs logic with conditions.

fields.title: Loops: for and while
fields.content: Repeat actions using for and while loops.

fields.title: Functions and Parameters
fields.content: Write reusable blocks of code with functions and pass values to them.

fields.title: Lists and Tuples
fields.content: Store and manage collections of items using lists and tuples.

fields.title: Introduction to Classes in Python
fields.content:
Classes are the foundation of object-oriented programming (OOP) in Python. They allow you to create your own data types that combine attributes (variables) and methods (functions).

Key Concepts:
Class ù a blueprint for creating objects.

Object ù an instance of a class.

Attributes ù variables that store data for the object.

Methods ù functions that define the behavior of the object.

fields.title: Introduction to Data Analytics
fields.content: Understand what data analytics is, its importance across industries, and how it's used to drive decision-making. Explore the different types of analytics: descriptive, diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive.

fields.title: Data Collection and Data Types
fields.content: Learn where data comes from and how to gather it ethically and effectively. Understand structured vs unstructured data, and the formats commonly used in analytics (CSV, JSON, databases, etc.).

fields.title: Data Cleaning and Preprocessing
fields.content: Discover common issues in raw data (missing values, duplicates, inconsistencies) and how to clean and prepare it using tools like Excel or Python (pandas). Learn about data normalization and formatting.

fields.title: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
fields.content: Explore datasets to identify patterns, trends, and anomalies. Practice summarizing data using statistics (mean, median, mode) and creating basic charts to visualize distributions and relationships.

fields.title: Introduction to Data Visualization
fields.content: Learn the principles of effective data visualization. Use tools like Excel, Tableau, or PythonÆs matplotlib/seaborn to create bar charts, line graphs, scatter plots, and dashboards.

fields.title: Basic Statistics for Analytics
fields.content: Understand core statistical concepts used in analytics: correlation, standard deviation, probability, and hypothesis testing. Apply these concepts to make sense of real-world data.

fields.title: Using SQL for Data Analysis
fields.content: Gain hands-on experience querying databases using SQL. Learn to filter, sort, join, and aggregate data from relational databases to support analytics tasks.
